execution: These are implementation acceptance specifications, not executed firmware, browser or device tests.
evidence_rules: Device cases require model, installed-byte identity, actual actions and observed messages/audio.
No filesystem, protocol, atomicity, write or rollback capability is invented by this fixture.

save_fixtures.initial: Stopped; REC off; no notes, transport requests, performance/project/clip flash owners; supported storage.
save_fixtures.expect: Only actual successful project_save rc=0 clears dirty and reports SAVED.
save_fixtures.retry: Edit again, repeat; new change remains dirty until next success.

save_fixtures.initial: Pattern playing, dirty project, REC off.
save_fixtures.expect: Request is queued. STOP does not prove write; only SAVED confirms completion after all guards clear.
save_fixtures.retry: If another guard remains, preserve pending state; do not power off.

save_fixtures.action: Request SAVE; stop while leaving REC on; then turn REC off.
save_fixtures.expect: REC OFF TO SAVE is a queued-save condition. No flash save while REC remains on, even when stopped.
save_fixtures.retry: After REC off and other guards clear, verify pending request succeeds.

save_fixtures.initial: Stopped, REC off, keyboard/pad/MIDI note held.
save_fixtures.action: Request SAVE, then release the note.
save_fixtures.expect: Held project note prevents flash write; a retained request can proceed only when notes and other owners clear.
save_fixtures.retry: Verify no premature SAVED; release/retry only after readiness.

save_fixtures.initial: Stopped in clip mode, clip controls recently active.
save_fixtures.action: Request SAVE; continue activity; then leave quiet.
save_fixtures.expect: No save during clip flash owner or before 4000 ms since activity; keep pending request. No STOP-only persistence claim.
save_fixtures.retry: After quiet and clear owners, verify SAVED, without claiming exact wall-clock latency.

save_fixtures.initial: Project transfer already busy; no earlier save pending.
save_fixtures.expect: PROJECT TRANSFER BUSY; request is not represented as a newly queued save.
save_fixtures.retry: Wait for transfer outcome and explicitly request SAVE after transfer completes.

save_fixtures.initial: Existing save_wait=1 followed by transient project/transport/notes/clip owner.
save_fixtures.action: Service autosave while busy, then clear owner.
save_fixtures.expect: Existing request is not consumed while busy. An engine readiness race returning UI_PROJECT_BUSY retains explicit intent.
save_fixtures.retry: Verify service resumes safely; distinguish from a new transfer-busy rejection.

save_fixtures.expect: NEWER DATA: NOT SAVED, save_failed true, dirty not cleared. No power-off recommendation or force/downgrade cure.
save_fixtures.retry: Retain unsaved work; resolve compatibility under approved procedure; success must be observed separately.

save_fixtures.expect: MEMORY FULL: NOT SAVED, save_failed true; pending attempt is not success.
save_fixtures.retry: Preserve work, follow approved capacity remedy, request again; another -7 remains failed.

save_fixtures.initial: Eligible save returns other nonzero rc.
save_fixtures.action: Request SAVE twice with first and second attempts failing.
save_fixtures.expect: SAVE FAILED after each failed attempt; dirty retained; no fabricated automatic durable retry/success.
save_fixtures.retry: Only rc=0 on a later eligible explicit attempt permits SAVED.

save_fixtures.expect: save_wait cleared and save_failed true; sticky warning remains; absence of a new SAVED banner cannot mean success.
save_fixtures.retry: No forced write; only validated adoption/unlock procedure may change protection.

save_fixtures.initial: Dirty; autosave enabled; no busy owner; stopped, REC off; quiet <4000ms or last autosave <20000ms.
save_fixtures.action: Wait/adjust controls; later meet both timing conditions.
save_fixtures.expect: No autosave while guards/timers block. AUTOSAVED only after actual success; dirty/save_failed clear on rc=0.
save_fixtures.retry: Autosave failure preserves failed state and gap semantics; do not equate elapsed timer with success.

save_fixtures.initial: SAVE held at least 250ms or SAVE used with a paste target.
save_fixtures.action: Hold SAVE, then release / select white target.
save_fixtures.expect: Hold invokes source-specific CHOOSE PASTE TARGET/paste grammar; it is not a universal save-status shortcut.
save_fixtures.retry: Teach unused press-release only under default mapping; get #891 approved control contract.

save_fixtures.initial: Saved project plus live chain/mutes/queued state.
save_fixtures.action: Observe save success, then proposed model-specific power-cycle test after authorization.
save_fixtures.expect: Recalled data matches actual persistent project scope. Live chain must not be promised persistent; characterize mute and queued-state scope separately.
save_fixtures.retry: No power-cycle performed in this stage; retain exact observation gaps.

save_fixtures.initial: Independent device Bluetooth-settings save retry underway.
save_fixtures.action: Observe BLUETOOTH SAVED / BT SAVE FAILED: RETRYING.
save_fixtures.expect: Bluetooth-settings persistence is not evidence the musical project was saved.

save_fixtures.initial: Calibration maps physical button differently from default.
save_fixtures.expect: Guide identifies default BT=SAVE/PATCH=HOME mapping and offers reviewed mapping help; no universal guarantee from printed legend alone.
save_fixtures.retry: Confirm actual mapping through approved contract before teaching a gesture.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.initial: Future qualified transport; occupied destination A; matching identity, readable validated A backup.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.action: Explicitly replace A, atomically check expected destination and commit.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: Only A changes; backup maps to old A, new incoming bytes read back. Warnings persist.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.retry: Any post-send uncertain result requires readback before retry.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.initial: Incoming file has the same display name as existing A.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.action: Download incoming file and acknowledge checkbox.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: Neither action qualifies as a backup of A. Replacement remains unavailable until actual destination bytes validate.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.retry: Read and validate old A, retain readable copy.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.initial: Destination occupied/unknown; reading slot fails, truncates or has invalid CRC.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: Backup unreadable/unverified; no empty-slot inference; zero writes.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.retry: Retry read or choose another verified slot.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: No overwrite; original destination unchanged; preview and warnings remain.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.retry: Retry backup; fresh explicit confirmation only after verification.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.initial: Backup permission denied, disk full, failed browser download or file cannot be reopened.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: No successful backup receipt; no warning-only bypass; zero writes.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.retry: Resolve host issue and validate a readable destination backup.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.initial: Backup of A verified; target changes to B, even with same name.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: Invalidate backup and authorization; exact slot identity remains visible; no writes.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.initial: Backup verified; same A changes after read.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: Device atomically rejects stale expected state; no overwrite. If protocol cannot do this, overwrite unavailable.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.retry: Read current A, produce new backup, reconfirm.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.initial: Device disconnect/reconnect, model change or new session after backup.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: History cannot restore verified identity or permission. Zero writes; old receipt remains historical evidence.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.retry: Re-identify, read target, requalify backup and confirm.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.scope: current file validation and proposed transport
destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: Reject without mutation; keep original input bytes. Exact validation class visible.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.retry: Select compatible valid input; do not patch bytes to force acceptance.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.initial: Valid DNPR with missing/changed sample references.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: Warnings remain attached to the same record at every state. No implicit PCM upload or full-kit claim.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.initial: Destination bank full or multi-record ZIP exceeds capacity.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: No silent eviction, overwrites or partial-success summary. Validate records/capacity before sending; any allowed subset must be explicit.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.retry: Choose capacity/explicit subset under actual transport contract.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: Outcome uncertain until verified readback; no blind overwrite retry or invented rollback. Distinguish queued/transferred/persisted.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.retry: Read actual destination and use qualified recovery procedure.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.initial: Slot explicitly read/verified empty; same identity and atomic check available.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: No fabricated backup of empty data. Fresh empty-state check protects against concurrent occupation.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.retry: If no longer empty, require real occupied-slot backup.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: Cannot manufacture backup or enable occupied-slot overwrite; retain old slot.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.retry: Choose verified empty writable user slot or await qualified export route.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.initial: Canonical schema1 actual Chicago1, origin user2, originalEngine Miami2; 22 params; no samples; valid CRC/length122.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.action: Import with target Chicago into native #900 and parse with explicit Chicago target in #901.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: Static trace: native accepts actual engine; current web rejects differing provenance. No executed reproduction is claimed.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.retry: Existing #901 owner disposes parity finding and adds narrow tests.

destination_and_parity_fixtures.initial: Canonical schema1 actual Miami2, origin user2, originalEngine Chicago1; 18 params; no samples; valid CRC/length118.
destination_and_parity_fixtures.expect: Actual engine mismatch must fail Chicago import. Target Miami exposes analogous provenance parity drift. Provenance never licenses cross-engine payload.

journey_fixtures.action: Explain product, hardware scope and first musical task before technical choice.
journey_fixtures.expect: Source-accurate identity/engines; no second-303 or working-demo claim.

journey_fixtures.actor: Existing player's nonempty project or accidental HOME/clip view
journey_fixtures.action: Follow first beat and return safely.
journey_fixtures.expect: Annotated span/mode; preserve work; exact return gesture supplied by #891, never invented.

journey_fixtures.action: Save/undo/perform with note held or REC on.
journey_fixtures.expect: Run save fixtures; document bounded undo and persistence; no power-off on queued/failed state.

journey_fixtures.action: Trace MIDI and audio in both directions.
journey_fixtures.expect: Name tested host/interface; no unsupported TRS route or universal driver claim.

journey_fixtures.action: Browse musical setup and installation expectations.
journey_fixtures.expect: Browsing remains useful; app/adapter/OS/transport proof distinct from firmware install.

journey_fixtures.action: Select role/preset, pair and control intended part.
journey_fixtures.expect: Approved labels and physical pairing evidence; no simultaneous-role promise.

journey_fixtures.action: Identify state, model, backup scope and permissions.
journey_fixtures.expect: Never request nonexistent DnBOX exports; no-write errors truthful.

journey_fixtures.action: Update and preserve separate project/sample data.
journey_fixtures.expect: Actual selected channel policy; backup/restore failure and partial-data outcomes distinct.
Preserve log/model/package; transfer != boot; no hidden chooser or generic rescue route.

journey_fixtures.action: Choose file object and use file-only path; future overwrite explicitly gated.
journey_fixtures.expect: Run slot fixtures; current file results do not imply a device write.

journey_fixtures.action: Open demo or honest availability explanation.
journey_fixtures.expect: Qualified real binary/audio before play claim; emulator != hardware.
Meaningful focus/selection/warnings; URL/history never restores write authority.

first_sound_fixtures.initial: BD steps already lit; transport advances; no audible output on chosen path
first_sound_fixtures.action: Use first-sound-branch.md; inspect monitoring/master, selected track, levels and mutes before any deliberate correction
first_sound_fixtures.expect: Same pattern retained; no repeated step toggles/clear/load/reset/reflash/power-cycle. Only identified correction changes; audible beat required for task success. Unknown output stays unresolved.
first_sound_fixtures.retry: Return to same pattern/failed point; explicit save contract follows audible success.

first_sound_fixtures.initial: PLAY does not advance; WAITING FOR CLOCK visible
first_sound_fixtures.action: Distinguish external-clock wait from moving-but-silent steps
first_sound_fixtures.expect: Preserve live clock context unless intentionally choosing reviewed standalone setting; no reset/reflash or false save/ready claim.
first_sound_fixtures.retry: Start intended clock or deliberately follow approved standalone clock choice, then same pattern.

first_sound_fixtures.initial: Pattern playing with documented KEY SOUND=STOPPED; BD selection produces no new audition hit
first_sound_fixtures.expect: Do not call F#3 mapping wrong or invent KEY SOUND=OFF. Running selection normally adds no stray hit; actual sequence/audio observation is separate.
first_sound_fixtures.retry: Use approved intended audition/monitoring path and return to same pattern.
